newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CSFB names Alan Smith as Pacific area vice-chair.
newsitem.headline: CSFB names Alan Smith as Pacific area vice-chair.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) said on Tuesday it had appointed Alan Smith as managing director and vice chairman of the company's Pacific region.

Smith, to be based in Hong Kong, will act as a senior banker for major regional corporate and government entities, helping to develop strategic initiatives and transactions in the region for Credit Suisse First Boston and its clients, the global investment banking firm said in a statement.
Smith was managing director of Jardine Fleming Group from 1983 to 1994, and chairman of the group from 1994 to 1996.
He retired from Jardine Fleming in September.
CSFB is the investment banking arm of Credit Suisse CSHZn.S.
